title: [Audit] 🚨 Security & Anomalies
description: Mean-severity risk scoring, privileged operations, failures and newly seen identities.

config.content:
### The activity most worth a second look

Each sensitive action earns a risk weight, from 10 for a workflow run up to 50 for a security setting change, while routine work scores zero. Raw records: [All audit events](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-00-all-events), [Raw signal feed](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-10-raw-signal-feed).

Panels rank identities by that risk, show newly seen identities, and list every security configuration change. Elastic's own routine API key clean-up is counted separately, so it never hides real changes.

**How to use it:** choose a Project, Person (email), API key or Client IP in the controls and set the time picker. Hover the ⓘ beside a panel title to see how it is scored.

- Weights: security config change 50, key invalidation 45, failure 40, anonymous denial 35, destructive change 30, other Kibana change 25, workflow run 10.
- Risk total is weight × events, not an event count. A failed action scores on its own row, marked (failed).
- Kibana’s own API-key clean-up and this suite’s automated install score 0; the line above a tile’s number counts them.
- Scope separates your identities, Elastic platform automation and unauthenticated requests; an identity without an email is not necessarily external.
- Click an API key or Principal id to filter the page or open Actor 360; a Cloud API key’s id also covers the API keys it created.

config.description: Average risk weight per scoring event, on the 0–50 scale, from 50 for a config change down to 10 for a workflow run. Routine activity scores 0 and is excluded, so read it with Scoring events beside it.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL OR event.outcome == "failure" OR event.action IN ("invalidate_apikeys","anonymous_access_denied") OR (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY event.action, scc = elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, event.outcome, service.name, et = MV_CONCAT(event.type, ","), housekeeping = (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND api_key.name IS NULL), suite_install = (kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND (kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" OR kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "elastic_cloud-audit-*") AND kibana.session.id IS NULL) | EVAL event.type = SPLIT(et, ","), elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change = CASE(scc, "present") | EVAL risk = CASE(housekeeping, 0, event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, event.outcome == "failure", 40, suite_install, 0, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (event.type == "deletion" OR event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | WHERE risk > 0 | STATS risk_total = SUM(risk * n), scoring_events = SUM(n) | EVAL mean_severity = ROUND(1.0 * risk_total / scoring_events, 1) | EVAL `Mean severity (of 50)` = mean_severity | KEEP `Mean severity (of 50)`

config.description: Security configuration changes: API keys created, changed or invalidated, and roles and user profiles written. Kibana’s routine API-key clean-up is left out; the line above the number counts it. Any other change deserves review.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL | EVAL housekeeping = (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND api_key.name IS NULL) | STATS `Config changes` = COUNT(*) WHERE NOT housekeeping, cleanups = COUNT(*) WHERE housekeeping | EVAL housekeeping_note = CASE(cleanups == 0, "no cleanups in range", CONCAT("excl. ", CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) <= 3, TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(cleanups), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(cleanups), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(cleanups), 3))), " cleanups"))

config.description: API key invalidation requests (one can revoke several keys): routine rotation, or a credential revoked in a hurry. Part of Config changes. Kibana’s routine API-key clean-up is left out; the line above the number counts it.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL | EVAL housekeeping = (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND api_key.name IS NULL) | STATS `Key invalidations` = COUNT(*) WHERE NOT housekeeping, cleanups = COUNT(*) WHERE housekeeping | EVAL housekeeping_note = CASE(cleanups == 0, "no cleanups in range", CONCAT("excl. ", CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) <= 3, TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(cleanups), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(cleanups), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(cleanups), LENGTH(TO_STRING(cleanups)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(cleanups), 3))), " cleanups"))

config.description: Events that failed: failed sign-ins (each attempt counted once), denials and any other failed action. Counted as on Identity & Access’s Failed or denied tile, so the two agree.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied") OR (event.outcome == "failure" AND (event.action IS NULL OR event.action != "realm_authentication_failed")) | STATS `Failures` = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE event.action == "anonymous_access_denied" | STATS `Anonymous denials` = COUNT(*)

config.title: 🚨 Config changes · up to 5 identity–action pairs, latest first (empty = good)
config.description: Security configuration changes (API keys, roles, user profiles) by identity and action, most recent first, with the latest target and how many targets. Many invalidations over many keys is rotation; over one key, a loop.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL AND NOT (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND api_key.name IS NULL) | GROK elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change """"name":"%{DATA:t_name}"""" | GROK elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change """"ids":\[%{DATA:t_ids}\]""" | GROK elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change """"id":"%{DATA:t_id}"""" | GROK elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change """"uid":"%{DATA:t_uid}"""" | EVAL target = COALESCE(t_name, REPLACE(t_ids, "\"", ""), t_id, t_uid) | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS events = COUNT(*), targets = COUNT_DISTINCT(SPLIT(target, ",")), latest = LAST(target, @timestamp), last_change = MAX(@timestamp) BY actor, api_key.name, user.name, action = event.action | SORT last_change DESC | EVAL actor_scope = CASE(actor IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana"), "platform", actor IN ("<anonymous>","<unauthenticated-cloud-access-token>","<unauthenticated-saml-user>","<unauthenticated-cloud-api-key>"), "unauthenticated", "tenant") | EVAL latest = REPLACE(latest, ",", ", ") | EVAL latest = CASE(LENGTH(latest) > 72, CONCAT(LEFT(latest, 71), "…"), latest) | EVAL latest = COALESCE(latest, "(none named in the payload)") | LIMIT 5 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)

config.title: Highest-severity actions, by how rare
config.description: The highest-severity scoring actions in range, placed by how often each happened: rarer is further left, so look top-left first. Color repeats the risk weight, blue for 10 up to deep red for 50. Hover for who and when.

config.title: Risk over time
config.description: Risk weight summed per interval, routine activity excluded, split by tenant identities, Elastic platform automation or unauthenticated requests. Spikes are clusters of privileged, failed or denied activity. A blank stretch means nothing scored then.

config.title: Identities by first appearance in range · newest 12 at most
config.description: Identities by their first signal event in the range, latest first. New reads “yes” unless they were already active as the range opened. A “yes” near the top is worth a question; widen the range to tell new from returning.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:monitor/xpack/esql/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/project/tags", "cluster:monitor/xpack/inference/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/query"))) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted") OR event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (event.action == "http_request" AND url.original IS NOT NULL AND url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/((internal|translations|app)/.*|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet).*|bootstrap(-anonymous)?[.]js.*|api/(core|licensing|banners|ui_counters)/.*|api/spaces/space([?].*)?)|https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/api/(saved_objects/(_import|_export)|[^?]*/(elastic_)?cloud-audit-).*") OR (kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL AND ((event.action == "saved_object_get" AND kibana.saved_object.type IN ("config","config-global")) OR (event.action == "saved_object_find" AND kibana.saved_object.type == "index-pattern"))) OR (kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND (kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" OR kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "elastic_cloud-audit-*") AND (event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") OR kibana.session.id IS NULL)))) | STATS first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), events = COUNT(*), ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.ip) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.name | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>") | SORT first_seen DESC, actor | EVAL actor_scope = CASE(actor IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana"), "platform", actor IN ("<anonymous>","<unauthenticated-cloud-access-token>","<unauthenticated-saml-user>","<unauthenticated-cloud-api-key>"), "unauthenticated", "tenant") | EVAL new_in_range = CASE(TO_LONG(first_seen) - TO_LONG(TO_DATETIME(?_tstart)) > (TO_LONG(TO_DATETIME(?_tend)) - TO_LONG(TO_DATETIME(?_tstart))) / 12, "yes", "no") | LIMIT 12 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)

config.description: The receipts behind the risk leaderboard: the identity and action pairs that added the most risk, with weight, count and last time. Risk total is weight × events. A rare action may be missing; see Highest-severity actions.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL OR event.outcome == "failure" OR event.action IN ("invalidate_apikeys","anonymous_access_denied") OR (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | STATS n = COUNT(*), last_ts = MAX(@timestamp) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.name, event.action, scc = elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, event.outcome, service.name, et = MV_CONCAT(event.type, ","), housekeeping = (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND api_key.name IS NULL), suite_install = (kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND (kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" OR kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "elastic_cloud-audit-*") AND kibana.session.id IS NULL) | EVAL event.type = SPLIT(et, ","), elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change = CASE(scc, "present") | EVAL risk = CASE(housekeeping, 0, event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, event.outcome == "failure", 40, suite_install, 0, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (event.type == "deletion" OR event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | WHERE risk > 0 | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>") | EVAL actor_scope = CASE(actor IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana"), "platform", actor IN ("<anonymous>","<unauthenticated-cloud-access-token>","<unauthenticated-saml-user>","<unauthenticated-cloud-api-key>"), "unauthenticated", "tenant") | STATS events = SUM(n), risk_total = SUM(risk * n), last_seen = MAX(last_ts) BY actor, actor_scope, api_key.name, user.name, action = event.action, weight = risk, failed = event.outcome == "failure" | EVAL action = CASE(failed AND NOT (action LIKE "*fail*" OR action LIKE "*denied*"), CONCAT(action, " (failed)"), action) | DROP failed | SORT risk_total DESC, actor, action | LIMIT 12 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)

config.title: Top failures and denials by identity and action · 12 at most (empty = good)
config.description: Failed and denied operations by identity and action, most frequent first, with the latest client IP and how many addresses were used. Many addresses behind one identity suggests a spray; “(internal)” is the platform’s own hop.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied") OR (event.outcome == "failure" AND (event.action IS NULL OR event.action != "realm_authentication_failed")) | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS events = COUNT(*), ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.ip), ip = LAST(client.ip, @timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY actor, user.name, action = event.action | SORT events DESC, actor, action | EVAL actor_scope = CASE(actor IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana"), "platform", actor IN ("<anonymous>","<unauthenticated-cloud-access-token>","<unauthenticated-saml-user>","<unauthenticated-cloud-api-key>"), "unauthenticated", "tenant") | EVAL ip = COALESCE(CASE(CIDR_MATCH(ip, "100.64.0.0/10"), CONCAT(TO_STRING(ip), " (internal)"), TO_STRING(ip)), "none recorded") | LIMIT 12 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)

config.title: Config-change event feed · newest 1,000 at most (empty = good)
config.description: Every security configuration change, one event per row, newest first. The payload is cut at the panel edge: expand a row to read it whole. Capped at the newest 1,000; the Config changes tile has the total.

config.title: Mutation feed · newest 1,000 at most
config.description: Every create, update and delete in Kibana and in Elasticsearch security configuration, newest first, with what each change named. Capped at the newest 1,000, so the result count is that cap; narrow the time range to reach older events.
